payload.text: The hrc document, instanced: seats hold their open questions as one annotation; generations hold attention and the runtime
KEY
hrc.seat  the continuity · key sessionRef · metadata lives here
hrc.generation  one per host session · ordered · attention is its field · live 24 h after its runtime ends
hrc.runtime  the process · key runtimeId · attachable
hrc.annotation  client-owned JSON on a seat or generation · c2 uses the seat subject only: asks (questions as rows), receipt, ping
